data.gender_notes: Domitille is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Roman family name Domitius, meaning 'belonging to the lord'. In Christian tradition, it is a feminine variation of Dominic. The name Domitille carries the meaning “Follower of Dominus (Lord)” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Domitille usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of dominus (lord) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion and loyalty to the divine.
data.etymology: Domitille belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower of Dominus (Lord).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Domitille total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

This name holds deep spiritual significance for those seeking a connection with their faith. It serves as a daily reminder of the importance of submitting oneself to God and living a life devoted to Him. The name Domitille evokes images of strength, steadfastness, and devotion, inspiring those who bear it to follow in the footsteps of Saint Dominic and live a life guided by the love and service of the Lord.
